Independent primary checks. (1) SRC-0004 / Canning–Larson arXiv 2208.02357v2 Lemma 10.6 states the CE evaluation surjectivity criterion for Gamma a collection of n distinct points on a smooth tetragonal curve, with W=W_f1⊕W_f2 and deg W_fi|C=4g+12-4fi; the ambient construction (eq. 10.9) evaluates on (P E^vee)^n with the open condition that the points are distinct. Thus the literature model already uses disjoint reduced support, not an arbitrary relative Cartier deg-6 divisor. (2) For rank-2 W at n=6 distinct points, pi_*(W|Gamma) is free of rank 12, so Fit_0(coker phi)=I_12(phi) by the definition of Fitting ideals (Stacks Project tag 07Z6 / Lemma 15.8.2: Fit_0 is generated by the full-size minors of a presentation); for the W_5 summand the target has rank 6, so Fit_0(coker phi_5)=I_6(phi_5); I_11(phi)=O_B is the rank-at-least-11 condition (corank of evaluation at most 1). These equalities are free-module bookkeeping only after Gamma→B is finite flat of the expected rank with the stated free targets—i.e. on the disjoint-sections / reduced-support model used by CL and by FND-0064, not automatically for non-reduced or non-flat relative divisors without re-proof. (3) FND-0099 already forces the two degree vanishings before Fit_0(coker phi)=Fit_0(coker phi_5) may be invoked; FND-0110 correctly imports that dependency and adds the disjoint-sections / reduced-support scope and the I_12/I_6/I_11 rank bookkeeping. Mild precision note only: pure freeness of pi_*(W|Gamma) of rank 12 needs finite flat Gamma of degree 6 more than the words 'six sections' per se, but the campaign's Conf_6/ordered-distinct model and CL Lemma 10.6 both implement exactly that as 6 disjoint sections on the reduced-support open; quantifying over 'any base with a relative deg-6 Gamma' without that scoping still overstates what the filtered snake and ATT-0048-style import deliver. ATT-0063/REV-0104/ATT-0048 artifacts are absent from the read-only workspace and were not re-audited; promotion rests on the mathematical scope obstruction, not attempt-local provenance. Distinct from FND-0099 (vanishings only), FND-0096 (Pic^0 universal Fitting, not CE W), and FND-0046 (geometric-points vs Fitting comparison): do not merge. Merge target: none.
